title: sos_origin: pin u64::MAX sequence boundary semantics with a test
description: 3x codereview on b7z9.121.4 (edge finding 4): OriginSequenceTracker.accept (rust/lichen-link/src/sos_origin.rs:66-84) has no u64::MAX boundary test. No arithmetic so no overflow, but the boundary semantics are unpinned: first-seq accepted at u64::MAX, then the origin is permanently locked out (no strictly-greater seq exists). Lock the behavior in with a test.
close_reason: Added tracker_u64_max_first_seq_locks_origin_out: first-seen u64::MAX accepted, no strictly-greater seq exists so equal/repeat rejected permanently — boundary semantics now pinned by test. 14/14 sos_origin tests pass with --features schnorr. 3x codereview (correctness/security/edge, kimi-k3): all PASS — no arithmetic on seq (comparison only, no overflow), test integrity independent of implementation, no cfg risk.
